components.name: Clients
components.description: Where people access the system.

components.name: Cloud
components.description: Where services and data live.

components.name: Web app
components.description: The experience in a browser.

components.name: Desktop
components.description: The installed workspace for large projects.

components.name: Mobile app
components.description: A mobile companion for reading and reviewing documents.

components.name: Application shell
components.description: Opens documents and manages the web workspace.

components.name: Editor
components.description: Edits document state and prepares its visual presentation.

components.name: Interface
components.description: Editing tools that translate user input into commands.

components.name: Authoring
components.description: Applies editing commands to the working document model.

components.name: Document state
components.description: Owns the working document model and coordinates saving.

components.name: Rendering
components.description: Turns document content into a visual preview.

components.name: History
components.description: Keeps local undo and redo snapshots of document state.

components.name: Scene graph
components.description: Arranges objects and requests text and image layers.

components.name: Text layout
components.description: Lays out text into drawable layers.

components.name: Image layers
components.description: Prepares image layers for composition.

components.name: Composition
components.description: Combines the rendered layers.

components.name: App services
components.description: Receive client requests and manage document persistence.

components.name: Asset services
components.description: Receive images, prepare previews and maintain the asset catalog.

components.name: Data storage
components.description: Stores document models and binary image files behind services.

components.name: Collaboration
components.description: Coordinates live sessions and delivers updates.

components.name: API Gateway
components.description: Routes incoming client requests to the responsible service.

components.name: Document service
components.description: Loads and saves document models, then announces changes.

components.name: Uploads
components.description: Accepts image uploads and stores their source files.

components.name: Processing
components.description: Prepares previews and thumbnails.

components.name: Catalog
components.description: Manages asset metadata and returns ready images to the workspace.

components.name: Documents
components.description: Stores saved document models and their versions.

components.name: Files
components.description: Stores original image files and generated previews.

components.name: Live sessions
components.description: Coordinates document sessions and broadcasts collaborative updates.

components.name: Notifications
components.description: Delivers save confirmations and session notifications to the interface.
